html:
Nothing in the machine stops 4. Its cores, memory and free disk would fit 4–6 jobs. What stops it:

  • A hard cap of 3 in the runner's code. Raising it is a small change, but it needs a release.
  • One shared account. All jobs share one service and one login. Going from 1 to 2 surfaced 4 bugs; each step up risks more of the same.
  • Start-up load. Two jobs starting at once pushed the load up and made health checks time out.

Proposal: raise the cap to 6, start with 4, and watch a week of runs.

Workers
